Subject: Vendor onboarding: banking info, remittance & invoice submission (Nimbus Analytics)

Hi Jill —

Thanks again for choosing Redwood. I'm kicking off the procurement onboarding for Nimbus Analytics so our Finance team can set you up for payments. To keep this lightweight, could you please confirm the following items? We can take the rest in DocuSign if that's easier.

1) Payment method preference: ACH (US) or wire? If ACH, please confirm your remittance email for confirmations (e.g., ap@nimbusanalytics.com). If wire, please note there may be an additional processing window and bank fees.

2) Bank details (for ACH): bank name, account type, account number (last 4 if you prefer), routing number, and the name on the account. If you prefer, a bank verification letter or voided check is fine.

3) Invoice submission: do you send invoices to ap@redwood.com, upload to our supplier portal, or both? For PO'd engagements, invoices should include the PO number in the invoice header.

4) Payment terms: confirm your standard terms (Net30, Net45, Net60) and whether you offer early-pay discounts.

5) Required paperwork: please attach your completed vendor onboarding form (I attached ours for your reference), W-9 (if US entity), and any bank verification docs.

We're aiming to approve the vendor in our system within 3 business days of receiving complete paperwork. Let me know if you prefer a quick call to walk through the form.

Thanks —
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Sales Ops
Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
(415) 555-0134

Hi Stephanie —

Thanks for the clear checklist. Quick answers below and attaching the onboarding form + W-9.

1) Payment method: ACH preferred for US payments. We can do wire if needed for international transfers. Remittance email: ap@nimbusanalytics.com

2) Bank details: to keep the thread secure, I attached our bank verification letter (Bank_Verification_Letter.pdf). If you need the full account number in the form, we'll provide it via the secure supplier portal or a secure DocuSign field.

3) Invoice submission: please route invoices to ap@nimbusanalytics.com. We can also upload to a portal if you provide credentials. Each invoice will reference the Redwood PO. If a PO is not generated, include "No PO" in the header and email me directly.

4) Terms: Standard Net30. We do offer 1.5% 10-day early-pay on invoices > $2,500 — happy to discuss.

5) Paperwork: Attached: Nimbus_Vendor_Onboarding_Form.pdf, Nimbus_W9_2026.pdf, Bank_Verification_Letter.pdf.

Let me know if you need anything else.
